asr_text: Some mornings, I choose a quiet corner because I need to think. On other days, I sit where talking is easy. A different desk can put me near people from another department. It can also give me space when a work relationship feels uncomfortable. Sometimes, I simply need room. Working from home gave me a place of my own, so I do not need one fixed place at the office. I like changing my surroundings. I choose a place that fits my mood and task. I also choose who is near me, or whether I want anyone near me at all.
